segments.text: Nano PDF Editor command line tool that lets you edit PDF slides using nothing but natural language powered by Nano
Banana Pro. Imagine saying update the graph to include data from 2025 and it just does it or turn this chart into a
bar graph done instantly. Nano PDF editor doesn't just generate new visuals.
